The story

Comedy
without
borders.

Emmanuel Carre—better known as Call Me Manny—turns the collisions between cultures, generations, and relationships into high-energy comedy.

Born in Cameroon, raised in France, and now based in South Florida, Manny built a global audience with characters and stories drawn from African family life. A former collegiate soccer player, he found his way to comedy after a heart condition changed the direction of his athletic career.
